_format: Each item: [sentence, mode] or [sentence, mode, expectedOperation]. Lists named *_no / *_unclaimed expect no drawing and no parentArtifactId. *_draw expect enabled. *_claim expect parentArtifactId set; third field is the expected operation: update | explain | view (another view of the same artifact) | any. ctx_contextual expects contextual === true. List 10 items are objects carrying their own context.
